reviews.text: Friendly and caring vet.

Unprofesional staff. Very expensive and what made me cancel the monthly plan with them and actualy change the vet to completely another company is the fact that they have a snicky way of charging you for things that it souposed to be free, part of the monthly plan which is extremely expensive anyway.

Very expensive and unjustified bills. Not to mention that they have a plan on which you pay for monthly dog checkup routines but when I went there on 2 ocasions they actualy have done some checkups which was based on the plan I already pay monthly and  they still charged me each time for little things that souposed to be on the plan. Not very profesional , reason why I've canceled my plan and changed the vet with someone else because I can not trust medivet anymore!

Very - very expensive and a quite helpless, I booked an appointment for routine vaccination, vet wouldn't do it because they didn't want to take responsibility to fill in my cat's passport. To be avoided.
Absolutely amazing  with chyna . Great  team

This is my new local vet, and I'm very happy with the care and service I've received. They treated my cat when she developed an abscess, and the team was professional, compassionate, and reassuring throughout.

Kyle was excellent with our 3-month old puppy - not only was he kind and caring with her, but he gave my partner and I confidence in his knowledgeable experience and care. He was happy to answer our (many) questions and give us helpful tips, going above and beyond what one might expect of a vet. I highly recommend him and the practice!
Fast, friendly service! Thank you!

We loved Medivet Barons Court! Our cat Maya is pretty fierce. They were incredibly patient with her and managed to get her blood tests done eventually! The Portuguese vet is particularly sweet and it is so clear he loves animals and he does his job with exceptional compassion and passion! Unfortunately, we have now moved but would definitively recommend this practice to pet parents!

Have had my Staffy Cyoress looked after by Barons Court Vets for over 11 years now and wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else.
The staff have  always treated me and Cypress like family from the beginning and have gone above and beyond with the care and kindness given not just for my dog but myself also.
I would absolutely recommend anyone to take their loved pet to this veterinary practice
Can’t thank you enough guys to all the staff over the years for everything you’ve done for us both

Thank you so much again for everything Glenn and Cypress ❤️
the dr and the tean stuff always look after us and my pet with lots of care! i apprecite
Tiago is a fantastic veterinarian - full of knowledge, good advice and care, very happy with the service we have received from Medivet.
Absolutely brilliant practice with a knowledgeable and kind team

Had a great experience, everyone was very nice and professional.
I really appreciate the fact that I received real and adequate advice for my dog, rather than feeling that I was being pushed to buy a product or service (which happens a lot in other practices)
Great service and advice. Recommend.
got three cats. Duchess, Wolfgang and Needy Ned. Medivet takes the absolute very best care of them. Im so grateful for that and so are my cats xx
Worst service ever. Please don’t go there if you want your dog to be treat properly
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Great practice with warm and nice practitioners
Very kind and effective treatment.
Always friendly and helpful. Very expensive but a consistently good service - and they like my cat!
I saw the practice vet Tiago Mota.  Pleased with the service.  Lady working reception desk was professional and welcoming.
Great people, always making my dog feel like home and taking the best care.

Had an appointment scheduled for my kitten (who HATES her carrier by the way), we came 5 minutes early and saw a sign on the door asking to be patient as the staff might be unable to open the door immediately busy with an emergency. We waited 30 minutes in the cold with an upset kitten until I attempted to call the practice and found out they are actually closed today.

I received an appointment confirmation and reminder today and yesterday, and no sign of the practice being closed anywhere. Very disappointing, especially since we don't live very close and have had to take pricy ubers both ways that nobody will reimburse us.

Fantastic service and professional veterinary staff, the team have looked after my 4 cats on an individual Basis  and also when times have come to an end, the support was exceptional, I continue to trust these professionals and consider them as part of my family.As always delivering the best service.
Tiago and the rest of the staff are always so helpful and patient with me even when I ask stupid questions.
Very friendly, upfront and cared for our cat greatly

I have had consistently good experiences with this vet - both the vets and the reception staff are friendly and helpful and look after my two rescue dogs really well. I was particularly impressed after one of my dogs had to undergo surgery at a different (non-Medivet) veterinary practice whilst we were on holiday, and Medivet West Ken were kind enough to remove the stitches without charging us when we got back to London.

We couldn’t be happier with the care and professionalism at MediVet, especially from Dr. Tiago and Dr. Ema. This is hands down the best veterinary clinic we’ve been to in London. Both doctors have been incredibly thorough and compassionate …
Great team. Quick and professional
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

We truly love visiting Dr. Sandra. She is compassionate and absolutely caring! We trust her completely with everything. She makes you feel at ease as an owner. She goes above and beyond her duties. Medivet should be proud to have her.
